title: MCP-SERVER-X formal closure took effect without a recorded operator ruling on conditions C5 and C8
impact: The decision was signed by a designated session at 09:07:52 on 2026-11-12, before the audit evidence existed, and authorizes closure only if C1-C10 hold. The terminal verifier passed C5 with deviations D-1/D-2 and left a strict C8 reading to the operator; the closure report leaves C5/C8 to the operator or roadmap-sync step; the repo itself records that no ruling exists. PR #480 flipped the roadmap status about 11 s after opening, before four of five required checks finished.
recommendation: Operator to record an explicit ruling on C5 and C8 (accept or void) and have the roadmap status re-confirmed against it.

title: MCP-SERVER-X certified surface and activation superseded; roadmap row still shows R-P8-01 open and omits MCP-RC
affected_invariant: IIAC ACT-N11 (no product path change after audited SHA); MCP v1 identity contract
impact: 189 product paths (23 MCP) differ between the P7 audit pin eadb1c21 and the baseline. MRC-1 (a45d0df1b) made the identity default fail-closed, so the certified ACC-10/11/12 semantics and the open R-P8-01 residual no longer describe the code. The activation record is bound at re-pin 2 (83d93909) and 71 product paths changed after its audited SHA (A0-007), so closure condition C6 would no longer hold. The re-pin PASS is the activation certifier's own, derived from CONDITIONAL and PASS_SCOPED audits, and CI contexts are stated as unverified green. Certification chains bound to the activation record: EVOL-X, ENT-AUDIT-X, MCP-SERVER-X (P6, P8, MCP-RC re-pins), HIST-P5 and the ACT-N11 recovery batch.
recommendation: Requalify MCP-SERVER-X under PDC-X MCP-RC with a delta audit and a new activation pin; update the roadmap row with the MCP-RC outcome.

title: ENT-AUDIT-X cites B6 pin add6a6ce next to TES' 32a96334 although it audited an earlier TES; OD-ENT-08 delegation imperfect
affected_invariant: one TES attested by one independent audit chain
impact: add6a6ce (2026-11-09) published an audit of TES b5c2481d (audit exec ee5470f5), whose manifest names certifier d90d76e6; the O1 delegation record lists d90d76e6 as an implementer session of the same stage. Roadmap, ledger and terminal report label add6a6ce 'B6' beside TES' 32a96334 (2026-11-10), which is attested only by the later W3 (fd572895) and W4 (5f178174) chain. Closure matrix P-1 acknowledges the phase split, but the headline pins mix two audit rounds. Separately, OD-ENT-08 was signed by session ent-sign-w5-od-08-2026-11-11 while the delegation designates ent-sign-w3-2026-11-09, and its delegation pin fb5c7801 is a blob hash, not a commit.
recommendation: Owner to restate the closure pins as TES' with W3/W4, relabel add6a6ce historical, record the W5 signing designation and use a commit-level delegation pin.

title: Compensating control behind FRZ-AUD-10 is repeatedly bypassed after ENT-AUDIT-X closure (OPEN-BP-01)
affected_invariant: FRZ-AUD-10 enforceable post-freeze audit policy (OD-ENT-02 compensating route)
impact: OD-ENT-02 judged hooks, CI contexts and merge discipline SUFFICIENT_COMPENSATING_SCOPED. Records show at least seven merges before required checks finished after closure (F-MCP-P6-GOV-001/003, P7-PROC-02/03, P8-PROC-01..03); development carries only deletion and non_fast_forward rules; the operator deferred enabling required checks through an unsigned chat record. The limitation is honestly scoped, but the compensating control has demonstrably not held.
recommendation: Operator decision: enable required checks on development or re-rule OD-ENT-02 sufficiency; until then keep FRZ-AUD-10 scoped.

title: process_enforced independence rests on string inequality and role labels (EVOL-X, ENT-AUDIT-X, MCP-SERVER-X, activation)
affected_invariant: IIAC role separation (N-01) and independent audit
impact: Validators check that three session-id strings differ and that no product path changed between audited and audit-execution SHA. EVOL-X implementer is HISTORICAL_UNRECORDED, ENT-AUDIT-X implementer is a certification-governance label, MCP implementer is a group label, auditor ids are not host-issued, and one git identity signs all commits. 36 of 39 manifests pass on this basis: a pass proves format, not independence. Operator lines written by delegated sessions use the same 'operator @' form as personal ones.
recommendation: Keep verdicts scoped as internal agent certification; add host-issued session identity or an operator-countersigned handoff before any unscoped claim.

title: PRE-ENT W6 cross-audit evidence is uncommitted local scratch; SKILL-X blocker G-SKILL conflicts with roadmap closure
impact: The 41-passed log lives in a local scratch directory outside the repo and full regression was not run. The matrix keeps G-SKILL (SKILL-X F-04, disable/remove/upgrade unsupported) as an open exact blocker while the roadmap shows SKILL-X CLOSED.
